description: What happened to a registration (register_shop answers `id`; the id is the key, nothing else is needed): status diagnosing | received | approved | rejected | active, whether the contact confirmed, the decision with its reason and when, where the feed came from (`feed_source` url | upload, and the upload's fingerprint), the public feed report (health, summary, counts, the first issues without item links), `next` = what happens now, and the shop's page once it exists. The contact e-mail and the feed address are never returned. Older requests of the feeds-job flow answer their own statuses (pending, feed_found, …). Public.

id.description: The request id from the registration answer.

name: get_shop_registration
title: Status of a shop registration
